paragraphs.text: 把「计划」和「实际看了什么」摆在一起看的 B 站观看统计插件
English | 中文
Bilibili Watch Statistics — see what you actually watched.
No runtime dependencies · QR sign-in · Local Markdown/HTML reports · DM & email digests · Model-writ
ten overview and plan status
A Bilibili watch-statistics plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) that puts your **plan** next to **what
you actually watched**.
It reads **your own** watch history from Bilibili's official API, computes a set of statistical fact
s locally, and then lets the host model write an overview, a plan-status section based on the real v
ideo titles, and a digest in the tone you configured. The result shows up as a session card, lands i
n a Markdown or HTML report, and can be delivered to your Bilibili DM inbox or an email address.
## Features
- **Statistics** — item count, mean completion, share after 22:00, autoplay chains and a comparison

against the last 14 runs; per day, week, month or custom range, with calendar or rolling windows
- *
*Model notes** — the model names this period's viewing state (for example "late-night recommendation
binge"), gives one line of evidence, a 150–350 word overview, and 1–3 plan-status items; every item

has to mention a specific video title or author and cite at least 2 record indexes
- **Interactions
** — likes, coins (with the coin count) and favorites inside the window, plus how many live streams
you watched and an estimate of the time spent there; favorites use the save time kept in the folders

, likes and coins are checked against each video you watched
- **Reports** — Markdown or a self-cont

ained HTML file, filed automatically into `daily/`, `weekly/`, `monthly/` and `custom/`
- **Notifica
tions** — Bilibili DM and email, either or both; the tone comes from one editable prompt that both c

hannels share
- **Scheduling** — daily, weekly, monthly or custom, with the trigger time picked from
dropdowns; it fetches history, writes the report and sends the digest by itself, no session needed
- **QR sign-in** — web and TV channels, switching to TV automatically when the web channel is blocke

d
- **Settings page** — sign-in, model, prompts, schedule, saving and notifications all live in DSH
Settings, so you never have to memorise tool names
## Requirements

- DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web profile
- Node.js 22 or newer
- A Bilibili account you can scan a QR co
de with, to read history; plus a **different** account to send DMs (the API rejects messages to your
th, to read history; plus a **different** account to send DMs (the API rejects messages to yourself)
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The package ships with defaults, so it works right after install. Refresh the GUI page and the tools
, cards and settings page appear. Once you edit `src/*.js`, restart `dsh web` — the ESM loader cache
s the old implementation and will not hot-replace it.
To change defaults, edit the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (see Configuration) or just use the settin
gs page, which writes an override layer with higher priority.
## Quick start

1. Open DSH Settings and pick **Bilibili watch statistics** in the sidebar
2. Under **Current status
**, click **Scan** → **Account that reads watch history**, then scan with the Bilibili app and confi

rm (the web channel falls back to TV automatically if blocked)
3. To receive DMs, sign in a second a

ccount the same way, this time choosing **Account that sends DMs**
4. Under **Model and tone**, pick

a provider and model; it also works without one, the report just lists numbers
5. Click **Run stati

stics now** and check **Latest output** to see what the digest looks like
6. For scheduled runs, ena
ble **Schedule**, choose a period and trigger time, then tick **DM** or **Email** under **Notificati
e**, choose a period and trigger time, then tick **DM** or **Email** under **Notification channels**
## Usage
### Settings page
| Area | What you can do |

| Current status | See your plan, the latest run, and whether both accounts are signed in |
| Scan |
Pick the role that reads history or the one that sends DMs, show a QR code, save credentials after

confirmation, or log out |
| Plan | Rewrite the plan text directly (same as `bili_intent_set`) |
| M
odel and tone | Pick provider / model, toggle "Model writes overview and plan status", edit prompts,

adjust max tokens and timeout |
| Schedule | Enable scheduling, choose period and window, pick hour
and minute from dropdowns (plus weekday for weekly, day of month for monthly), and see the next fir

e time and the last trigger result |
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy
- Reads Bilibili's official API only, and only your own watch history; no write operations except DM

s, and those go only to the recipient you specify
- Statistics and reports are generated locally and

never uploaded; model calls go to the provider you configured in DSH
- The repository contains no a
ccount credentials. The `appkey` / `appsec` used by the TV sign-in channel are public constants of B

ilibili's TV client and belong to no personal account
- Your SESSDATA, bili_jct, UID and email autho
rization code live only in your local `state_dir` or profile config
## Known limitations
- The watch-history API **does not return the source**, so "did I click this or did autoplay?" can o
nly be inferred from completion, duration and consecutive plays. Rules vote for a label with a confi
dence, then the model turns it into a human-readable name using the titles; without a model you see

the rule label and its confidence
- Paging is bounded by `max_pages`, so very long windows may be tr
uncated; the API is rate limited (400 ms interval by default) and retries with backoff on `-352` / `

-412`
- Model output depends on the host's `llm` service: with no provider/model selected, on timeou
t, or on error, the report keeps its numbers and notifications fall back to the template digest, wit
h no error raised; when output is cut off by tokens you get a hint, and raising `max_tokens` fixes i

t
- The email client is a minimal built-in SMTP implementation without OAuth2; Bilibili DMs are plai

n text and require different sender and receiver accounts
- The web QR channel may be blocked by Bil

ibili's risk control (`-412`); the plugin then switches to the TV channel automatically
- Likes and
coins carry no timestamp, so they are checked as "still liked / still coined?" on the videos watched
inside the window, bounded by `interaction_max` (favourites and fully-watched videos are checked fi
rst); live streams are counted from the records and their time is estimated from the gaps, capped at
30 minutes per session
